lines: Main roya pardes mein, bheega maa ka pyaar
couplets.en: I wept far from home, and even there my mother's love was wet with tears.

lines: Dukh ne dukh se baat ki, bin chitthi bin taar
couplets.en: Sorrow spoke to sorrow without a letter or a telegram.

lines: Chhota kar ke dekhiye, jeevan ka vistaar
couplets.en: See how small the vastness of a life can be.

lines: Aankhon bhar aakaash hai, baahon bhar sansaar
couplets.en: The sky fits in a glance, the world in an embrace.

lines: Leke tan ke naap ko, ghoome basti gaaon
couplets.en: We went from village to village with the measure of our bodies.

lines: Har chaadar ke gher se, baahar nikle paaon
couplets.en: Our feet stuck out from under every cover.

lines: Sab ki pooja ek si, alag alag hai reet
couplets.en: The same devotion takes a different form in every rite.

lines: Masjid jaaye maulvi, koyal gaaye geet
couplets.en: The cleric goes to the mosque, and the koel sings.

lines: Pooja ghar mein moorti, Meera ke sang Shyam
couplets.en: In the household shrine, Shyam stands beside Meera.

lines: Jiski jitni chaakri, utne uske daam
couplets.en: Each receives according to what they give in service.

lines: Nadiya seenche khet ko, tota kutre aam
couplets.en: The river waters the fields, and the parrot pecks at a mango.

lines: Sooraj thekedaar sa, sab ko baante kaam
couplets.en: Like a foreman, the sun gives everyone their work.

lines: Saaton din Bhagwaan ke, kya Mangal kya Peer
couplets.en: All seven days are God's, so what does it matter whether it is Tuesday or Monday?

lines: Jis din soye der tak, bhookha rahe faqeer
couplets.en: The day the beggar sleeps late, he goes hungry.

lines: Achhi sangat baith kar, sangi badle roop
couplets.en: In good company, we begin to change.

lines: Jaise mil kar aam se, meethi ho gayi dhoop
couplets.en: Even sunlight grows sweeter when it touches a mango.

lines: Sapna jharna neend ka, jaagi aankhen pyaas
couplets.en: Dreams flow like water through sleep, and the eyes wake thirsty.

lines: Paana, khona, khojna, saanson ka itihaas
couplets.en: A life is the story of finding, losing, and looking again.

lines: Chaahe Gita baanchiye, ya padhiye Quraan
couplets.en: Read the Gita, or turn to the Quran.

lines: Mera tera pyaar hi, har pustak ka gyaan
couplets.en: What every book knows is the love between us.
